description: The pie chart, titled "Distribution of articles across media outlets," illustrates the number of articles sourced from various media organizations across 18 distinct categories. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, category labels are positioned outside the pie, with thin lines connecting them to the smaller slices where necessary, while raw numerical values (rather than percentages) are displayed directly inside each slice. Visually, the named media outlet slices are arranged in descending order of size counter-clockwise, starting from the right. The slices include Breitbart (blue, 14), Drudge Report (orange, 8), The Daily Caller (green, 8), The Huffington Post (red, 7), NPR (purple, 6), Vox (brown, 6), The Guardian (pink, 5), BBC (grey, 5), RT (yellow, 4), Daily Kos (light blue, 3), National Review (teal, 3), Daily Mail (orange, 3), Red State (green, 3), Fox News (red, 3), CNN (purple, 3), PoliticusUSA (brown, 3), and Shareblue (pink, 3). Finally, an "Other" category (grey, 13) is positioned clockwise from the largest slice, completing the circle. There are no visually emphasized, exploded, or offset slices in the chart.
